reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: Green Finance Facility - Sparkasse Bank AD Skopje

description.narrative: Provision of a long-term senior unsecured loan of up to EUR 7 million to be provided in two equal tranches for on-lending to small and medium-sized enterprises ("SMEs") in North Macedonia for investments in renewable energy ("RE") and energy efficiency ("EE"). The loan comes as the pilot project under the Green Finance Facility - North Macedonia (the "GFF", the "Facility"), established in partnership with UNDP, with contributions from the Joint SDG Fund and the government of North Macedonia. The loan aims to support green economy investments in eligible RE and EE measures under the Bank's Green Economy Transition ("GET") approach. The project will build on the momentum created to date and it will focus on the competitiveness and climate resilience of SMEs in North Macedonia.
